records.text:
Lou Gehrig was born June 19, 1903, in New York City. His story is getting a new home: the Lou Gehrig Fan Club website relaunches in 2027.

Explore his story with the Lou Gehrig Fan Club:
https://lougehrigfanclub.com

photo.alt_text: Sepia photo of four men standing in front of a crowd behind chicken-wire fencing. One wears a "Larrupin' Lous" jersey and one wears a "Bustin' Babes" jersey and a bowler hat. Between them a man in an overcoat and a cap marked "LL" holds a baseball, and at the left a man wears a white cardigan and a bow tie.
